contact_provenance_rule: FK/collision-estimated contact must be labeled model_estimate; it is not measured force/COP truth

forbidden_shortcuts: fixed root-z used to hide a dynamic failure
forcing both feet to remain in contact
post-hoc joint clamp presented as native retarget quality

silver_contact.static_exception: standing and upper-only clips can remain Bronze; they are not promoted to dynamic Silver by absence of motion

gold_dynamic.controller: pre-registered position-PD or teacher; exact default pose, gains, action scale and rate must be in the report

event_semantics.kick_or_leg_raise: intended swing foot must truly leave contact and the stance foot must accept support
event_semantics.lunge: specified lead foot, step length, pelvis height and trunk direction must be retained
event_semantics.squat: pelvis height excursion must be retained without foot contact cheating
event_semantics.turn: world yaw direction and magnitude must match the source intent

calibration_rule: These absolute thresholds are frozen for Phase0 smoke. Before a full-corpus run they may be revised once, using only the 24-motion diagnostic panel and with an explicit old/new diff; held-out results cannot tune thresholds.
